paragraphs: Nimble sells software for K-12 hiring, and its home page describes partnering with states to connect schools and teachers. The home page says Nimble supports states, districts, and teachers in one platform, with sections addressing Teachers, State DOEs, Districts, and Principals. Five products are named: Nimble Insight, Nimble Discover, Nimble Navigate, Nimble Connect, and Nimble Hire. Nimble Insight tracks teacher vacancies statewide for education leaders, and Nimble Hire brings districts and teachers into one connected system.

The case studies page names Nebo School District, School City of East Chicago, and Wawasee. It credits Nimble with faster hiring at School City of East Chicago and at Wawasee, and says Nebo School District implemented the applicant tracking system in 2022.

quote.text: Nimble brings clarity, speed, and confidence to K-12 hiring by partnering with states to connect schools and teachers
